aom.notes: PATENTS is the Alliance for Open Media Patent License 1.0, which s1.2.1(b) requires to accompany binary distributions (no SPDX id, so not in the expression). third_party/fastfeat (BSD-3-Clause) and third_party/vector (MIT) are compiled into libaom (av1/av1.cmake, encoder); third_party/x86inc (ISC) is the x86 assembly macro layer, so it only reaches the x86_64 DLL - shipped for both packs. third_party/libyuv and libwebm are linked only into apps/examples (ENABLE_APPS/EXAMPLES=OFF in the recipe) and CONFIG_HIGHWAY defaults to 0, so their texts are not shipped.
aom.spdx: BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause AND MIT AND ISC

archive.notes: COPYING names two files that are "also subject in whole or in part to a 3-clause UC Regents copyright"; that BSD notice requires reproduction in binary distributions and exists only in the files' header comments, so the two header comments are shipped as verbatim line excerpts. archive_parse_date.c is public domain; the blake2 files are CC0-1.0 OR OpenSSL OR Apache-2.0 (CC0 chosen, no notice needed).
archive.spdx: BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause AND (CC0-1.0 OR OpenSSL OR Apache-2.0)

cairo.notes: COPYING: every file of the library (src/) is available under LGPL-2.1 or MPL-1.1, at the recipient's choice; both texts ship.

cfitsio.notes: The recipe URL could not be fetched directly when this was vendored (heasarc.gsfc.nasa.gov served a TLS certificate for CN=go-vip.co; plain http returned 404). The tarball was retrieved from the Internet Archive's raw capture of that exact URL (https://web.archive.org/web/2026id_/<url>) and its sha256 matches the recipe's, so the text is from the pinned archive. It is also byte-identical to licenses/License.txt at upstream tag cfitsio-4.7.0 (commit d6d27653740864a0483e74cff23c53e34e1dceee).

dicom.notes: libdicom statically includes uthash (header-only), forced from WrapDB by the recipe (--force-fallback-for=uthash); see the uthash entry.

exif.notes: COPYING is the LGPL-2.1 text. Source headers: most files LGPL-2.0-or-later, a few LGPL-2.1-or-later (SPDX-License-Identifier lines in libexif/).

ffi.notes: LICENSE-BUILDTOOLS covers build scripts only and is not shipped.

fftw.notes: COPYRIGHT is the project's licence statement (GPL version 2 or any later version); COPYING is the GPL-2.0 text. GPL: the corresponding source must be offered alongside the binary.

fontconfig.notes: COPYING carries every notice in the library, including the HarfBuzz-derived fcatomic.h/fcmutex.h (Old MIT), fcfoundry.h (MIT), public-domain fcmd5.h/ftglue.[ch], and the Unicode terms-of-use note for the CaseFolding.txt data compiled into fccase.h (Unicode-TOU).

freetype.notes: Dual FTL / GPL-2.0-or-later (LICENSE.TXT); this pack uses it under the FTL, whose clause 2 requires a credit in the product documentation, e.g. "Portions of this software are copyright (c) <year> The FreeType Project (https://freetype.org). All rights reserved." (FTL.TXT). The BDF and PCF drivers are under an X/MIT-style licence whose text is in src/bdf/README and src/pcf/README. The gzip module (Zlib) and the HarfBuzz-derived autofit files (Old MIT, same text as the harfbuzz entry) carry no binary-notice requirement beyond what ships here.

glib.notes: In the tarball COPYING is a symlink to LICENSES/LGPL-2.1-or-later.txt; the target is shipped as COPYING. Files the four DLLs are built from carry SPDX LGPL-2.1-or-later (a few "LGPL-2.1-or-later or AFL-2.0"; LGPL chosen); gnulib parts are LGPL-2.1-or-later per .reuse/dep5. gvdb (subproject, forced fallback) is LGPL-2.1-or-later. The only MIT-licensed code (xdg-user-dir lookup in gutils.c) is in the "#else /* default is unix */" branch and is not built for Windows. PCRE2 is NOT bundled: the recipe applies glib-2-without-gregex.patch, and the DLLs contain no PCRE2/GRegex code. proxy-libintl is statically linked in; see its entry.

harfbuzz.notes: COPYING: the "Old MIT" licence (SPDX MIT-Modern-Variant). src/ms-use/COPYING (MIT, Microsoft) covers the USE data from which the compiled hb-ot-shaper-use-table.hh is generated.

heif.notes: Library sources: "either version 3 of the License, or (at your option) any later version" (LGPL). COPYING contains the LGPL-3.0 text AND the full GPL-3.0 text that LGPL-3.0 incorporates (from line 176), plus the MIT text for the (unshipped) examples, so the GPL-3.0 companion text travels in this file; no separate copy is vendored.

highway.notes: LICENSE holds both the Apache-2.0 and BSD-3-Clause texts. hwy/contrib/random (CC0-1.0) is not part of libhwy.

imagemagick.notes: The ImageMagick License is Apache-2.0-derived: s4(d) requires the NOTICE file to accompany redistributions. Magick++/LICENSE belongs to the C++ binding, which the recipe disables (--without-magick-plus-plus).

imagequant.notes: The BSD-2-Clause 2.4.1 fork (github.com/lovell/libimagequant), not the GPL-3.0 2.5+ upstream.

imath.notes: Statically linked into: openexr (imath_BUILD sets -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF; no Imath DLL is bundled); no mxe() key. Not in versions.json; build-win64-mxe's README lists it.

jxl.notes: PATENTS is Google's additional patent grant. lib/extras (LICENSE.apngdis) is only used by the tools, which the recipe disables.

lcms.notes: The GPL-3.0 fast_float/threaded plugins are off by default (meson options fastfloat/threaded = false) and the recipe does not enable them, so their COPYING.GPL3 texts are not shipped.

llvm-runtime.notes: mxe() attributes libc++.dll and libunwind.dll to key None (MXE_UNLISTED); this is that entry. Built from the llvm-project 23.1.2 tarball by MXE's llvm.mk (llvm-mingw plugin, kleisauke/mxe branch llvm-mingw-20260924 @ c36160b231e66e1cbe032ed54aef7617e8b259da, the branch the recipe's container/base.Dockerfile clones). libc++abi is linked statically into libc++.dll (LIBCXX_ENABLE_STATIC_ABI_LIBRARY); compiler-rt builtins are linked statically into every DLL (the LLVM exception waives notice for such embedded object code; its text ships anyway). Code predating the relicensing is NCSA OR MIT (legacy section of each LICENSE.TXT); libc++'s Ryu (src/ryu) is also BSL-1.0, which exempts object code.
llvm-runtime.spdx: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception AND (NCSA OR MIT) AND BSL-1.0

matio.notes: LicenseRef-snprintf.txt covers the bundled snprintf.c; its conditions only bind source distributions, so it is shipped for completeness rather than by requirement.

mingw-w64.notes: Statically linked into: every DLL (mingw-w64 CRT startup code and libmingwex); no mxe() key. mingw-w64 commit 57b595039040eaa15bece85b7cc71d952281b269 (plugins/llvm-mingw/overrides.mk). The runtime notice file exists for exactly this purpose ("statically linked against the MinGW-w64 runtime ... notices are included when distributing the code in binary form"). winpthreads is NOT linked: the llvm-mingw plugin stubs out pthreads_BUILD (libc++ uses Win32 threads) and only empty libpthread.a archives are created, so mingw-w64-libraries/winpthreads/COPYING is not shipped. The Wine-derived headers (LGPL) are declarations only.
mingw-w64.spdx: ZPL-2.1 AND ISC AND BSD-2-Clause AND dtoa AND SunPro AND MIT

mozjpeg.notes: mozjpeg commit 08265790774cd0714832c9e675522acbe5581437. The IJG licence lives in README.ijg. A binary distribution's documentation must state "This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group." (LICENSE.md s2.1, IJG clause 2).

nifti.notes: LICENSE: "Nifticlib code is released into the public domain"; no SPDX id exists for this statement.

openexr.notes: The release archive has no top-level directory. PATENTS: DreamWorks' DWA compression files are BSD-3-Clause with an additional patent grant, or Apache-2.0, at the licensee's option. Imath is statically linked in; see its entry.

openjpeg.notes: thirdparty/ (lcms2, libpng, astyle) is only used by the codec tools, not libopenjp2.

openslide.notes: meson.build: license LGPL-2.1-only; source headers: "version 2.1" without "or later".

pango.notes: Source headers: GNU Library GPL "version 2 of the License, or (at your option) any later version" (meson.build says "LGPLv2.1+"). COPYING is the LGPL-2.0 text.

poppler.notes: README.md: poppler, like xpdf, is GPL. xpdf-derived files carry only the Glyph & Cog copyright (xpdf: GPL-2.0 or GPL-3.0); poppler-authored files say "GPLv2 or later". Conservative reading: the combination is distributable under GPL-2.0 or GPL-3.0; both texts ship (COPYING = GPL-2.0, COPYING3 = GPL-3.0). GPL: the corresponding source must be offered alongside the binary.

proxy-libintl.notes: Statically linked into: glib (built with --default-library=static and substituted for gettext); no mxe() key (it is in versions.json but owns no DLL). Source headers: GNU Library GPL "version 2 of the License, or (at your option) any later version"; COPYING is the LGPL-2.0 text.

raw.notes: LibRaw is LGPL-2.1 or CDDL-1.0 at the user's choice (COPYRIGHT). The DCB/FBDD demosaic code (always compiled) is BSD-3-Clause, whose notice exists only in the header of src/demosaic/dcb_demosaic.cpp, shipped as a verbatim line excerpt (CRLF line endings, as upstream). The BSD-style X3F code is compiled out (USE_X3FTOOLS is not defined). COPYRIGHT also mentions pieces of Adobe DNG SDK 1.4 (MIT); no further notice for them exists in the archive.

rsvg.notes: Cargo.toml: license LGPL-2.1-or-later. The Rust crates statically linked into librsvg-2-2.dll are in the rsvg-crates entry, the Rust standard library in the rust-std entry.

rsvg-crates.notes: Statically linked into: rsvg; no mxe() key. The 128 crates.io crates compiled into librsvg-2-2.dll: cargo tree -p librsvg-c --target {x86_64,aarch64}-pc-windows-gnullvm -e normal,no-proc-macro over librsvg 2.63.2's Cargo.lock AFTER the recipe's patches/librsvg-2-fixes.patch (which drops gif, image-webp, color_quant, weezl 0.1, quick-error 2 and the cairo-rs pdf/ps features); meson builds without avif (no dav1d in the recipe) and without pixbuf. Each .crate's sha256 equals its Cargo.lock checksum; "from" is "<.crate URL>!/<member>". Files are every licence/notice file at the crate root, verbatim. x86_64-only crates (absent from the arm64 build): core_detect 1.0.0, multiversion 0.9.0, safe_arch 1.2.0. selectors 0.40.0 ships no licence file - neither the .crate nor its repository (servo/stylo @ 67faaab3ff7aa66780ec1d0f51ca47e177b812d3) has one; it declares MPL-2.0 in Cargo.toml and every source file carries the MPL-2.0 Exhibit A header; the MPL-2.0 text ships with cssparser 0.37.0. MPL-2.0 s3.2(a): recipients of the executable must be told where the source is - MPL crates: cssparser 0.37.0, cssparser-color 0.5.0, dtoa-short 0.3.5, selectors 0.40.0, each at https://crates.io/crates/<name>/<version>. Crate SPDX expressions are the crates' own Cargo.toml "license" fields ("/" normalised to OR).
rsvg-crates.spdx: ((Apache-2.0 OR MIT) AND BSD-3-Clause) AND (0BSD OR MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND Apache-2.0 AND (Apache-2.0 OR MIT) AND (BSD-3-Clause OR Apache-2.0) AND MIT AND (MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND (MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR Zlib) AND (MIT OR Zlib OR Apache-2.0) AND MPL-2.0 AND Unicode-3.0 AND (Unlicense OR MIT) AND (Zlib OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT)

rust-std.notes: Statically linked into: rsvg (librsvg is built with cargo -Zbuild-std=std,panic_abort, build-std-features optimize_for_size,compiler-builtins-c; plugins/llvm-mingw/rust.mk); no mxe() key. The recipe pins rustc-nightly-src.tar.xz of 2026-09-24 (263 MB, so not fetched); its sha256 is the one in that date's signed channel-rust-nightly.toml, which also pins git commit 6eeff9a52c3e35c4c4cbf5651f342dcd2191866f and the rust-src component these texts are read from (rust-src-nightly.tar.xz, sha256 2dd288734762bb7e541237fd9de6c79e78c86bd0df045257fc4276994f193c80; "from" is "<archive URL>!/<member>"). COPYRIGHT/LICENSE-* are byte-identical to the repository root at that commit. Crates compiled for {x86_64,aarch64}-pc-windows-gnullvm (cargo tree over library/ with those features, normal edges): std, core, alloc, panic_abort, unwind, std_detect, windows-link, rustc-std-workspace-{core,alloc}, compiler_builtins (in-tree; MIT AND Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception, libm MIT), backtrace, core_simd and core_arch (in-tree via #[path]), and the vendored cfg-if 1.0.4, hashbrown 0.17.1, libc 0.2.189, rustc-demangle 0.1.28.
rust-std.spdx: (MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND MIT AND Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception

sqlite.notes: SQLite is public domain (the "blessing" at the top of sqlite3.c); the amalgamation ships no licence file. autosetup/LICENSE and tea/license.terms cover build tooling and the Tcl extension, not libsqlite3.

tiff.notes: LICENSE.md includes the Berkeley notice for tif_lzw.c.

uhdr.notes: LICENSE: "distributed under the terms of both the MIT license and the Apache License (Version 2.0)" (both texts inside; LICENSE-MIT/LICENSE-APACHE are split copies). image_io (Apache-2.0) and its modp_b64 (BSD-3-Clause) are compiled into libuhdr (CMakeLists.txt globs image_io/src/**). The Adobe NOTICE ("This product includes Gain Map technology under license by Adobe.") is shipped as upstream asks.

uthash.notes: Statically linked into: dicom (header-only macros, pulled from WrapDB by libdicom-1.3.0/subprojects/uthash.wrap, wrapdb_version 2.3.0-2, because the recipe passes --force-fallback-for=uthash); no mxe() key. Source and sha256 are the wrap file's source_url/source_hash. Its only condition binds source redistributions; shipped for completeness.

vips.notes: LICENSE is byte-identical to the LICENSE in the build-win64-mxe zip. libnsgif (MIT) is bundled in libvips and compiled into the GIF loader.

webp.notes: PATENTS is Google's additional patent grant for the WebM codecs.

xml2.notes: Copyright: everything is MIT "except where otherwise noted in the source code (e.g. the files dict.c and list.c, which are covered by a similar licence but with different Copyright notices)". Those two ISC-style notices ("this permission notice appear in all copies") exist only in the file headers, shipped as verbatim line excerpts.

zstd.notes: Dual-licensed BSD-3-Clause (LICENSE) or GPL-2.0-only (COPYING); this pack uses the BSD terms.
